item.title: Towards Irrigation Modernisation in the Ogun-Oshun River Basin, Nigeria: Opportunities, Challenges, and Improvement Options
item.description: Irrigated agriculture is very crucial in achieving the Sustainable Development Goal (SDG) and ensuring food security in Nigeria. item.title: Analysis of Bama Gravel as Coarse Aggregate in Concrete Production: A Review
item.description: Bama gravel, a naturally occurring riverbed aggregate in Borno, Northeastern Nigeria, is widely used in concrete production due to its abundance and low cost. This naturally occurring aggregate from Bama ridge, extends over a distance of approximately 300 km. In the past few years, attention has been shifted by researchers to exploring the engineering potential of the aggregate. item.title: Optimization of Performance Parameters of an Off-Grid Wind Solar Hybrid Power System Using HOMER Pro for Enhanced Energy Reliability at Kashim Ibrahim University, Maiduguri
item.description: Kashim Ibrahim University, Maiduguri faces persistent energy shortages due to unreliable grid supply and reliance on diesel generators. Earlier proposals for stand alone solar PV systems overlooked wind resources and full techno-economic optimization, highlighting the need for a more resilient hybrid approach. item.title: Production of Goat Horn Particles Reinforced Epoxy Resin Composite for Automobile Brake Pad

item.title: Limited Adoption of Advanced BIM Tools in Architectural Education: Evidence from Southwestern Nigeria
item.description: This study examined the availability and utilization of Building Information Modelling (BIM) tools among architectural educators in three public universities in southwestern Nigeria. item.title: Particle Swarm Optimization Based Resource Allocation for High Altitude Platform Networks
item.description: High Altitude Platforms (HAPs) are emerging as cost-effective aerial communication nodes capable of providing broadband wireless coverage over large geographical areas. item.description: The environmental and health risks posed by conventional gasket materials such as asbestos and synthetic rubbers have created a pressing need to develop sustainable alternatives for mechanical sealing applications. item.title: Geotechnical Performance Evaluation of Flood-Impacted Subgrade of Fori Road, Maiduguri, Borno State, Nigeria
item.description: This research investigates the properties and suitability of subgrade soils in Fori area of Maiduguri for road pavement foundations in flood prone environments. item.description: The rising cost and environmental impact of steel reinforcement pose significant challenges to the construction industry.
